input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: Argument.get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) unconditionally. The new return type is tuple[str, str], but self.help is None when the argument has no help text.
- rationale: Trigger: a command where one argument has help and another does not. The old code in format_arguments substituted (metavar, "") via `or`, but that fallback was removed. The record is now (metavar, None), and formatter.write_dl will likely fail on the None description (for example in wrap_text or len) and raise during --help. The docstring says an empty description is returned, which the code does not do.
critique: The finding names the same mechanism as the label. get_help_record returns self.help as None for an undocumented argument, the `or` fallback in format_arguments was removed, and write_dl then fails on the None description during --help when one argument has help and another does not.
